{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the means to ensure they are captured in output
print(mean_flipper_by_species)"}
